risk_note: F1-01-nav (规划/05 §3.11.3, D10-724 ①). The H5 app shell calls ui.setNavBar once each time the route path changes (new nav-bar.ts, guarded by has(), failures swallowed); query-only changes do not resend. Titles come only from dictionary keys: /earnings uses earnings.title; the other eight h5 routes have no page-title key in contracts/texts.default.json yet, so they are sent without a title and carry a TODO with the proposed key names (content contract ticket requested; a tightening task follows once the keys exist). index.html title is 凑狸; help-home's drawn title becomes an sr-only h1. Setnavbar calls only in the shell (conformance excepted). Non-funds. Known transitional gaps recorded as follow-ups: /help shows no visible title until help.title exists, and a browser-style back from /earnings to a keyless route may leave the old native title. Rule tests written by an independent Claude in two rounds (round 2 only shortened waits after red/1 timed out); Claude spec-test review r1 pass (three S2 carried into the implementation constraints), round 2 incremental review pass; red on the local container (red/2). Implementation by Opus 5.5; local container verify-fast and browser green on the same tree. Independent Claude general review r1 pass (two S2, both from the missing keys). Written by hand.

reviews.note: round 1 pass with two S2 caused by the eight missing page-title keys (stale native title after a browser-style back; /help has no visible title for now); both resolved by the follow-up tightening after content adds the keys

spec_test_review.note: fresh Claude subagents: round 1 pass with three S2 carried into the implementation constraints; round 2 (waits shortened after a timed-out red run) incremental review pass; tests written by an independent Claude (claude-run.sh)
